name: Archean

config.title: server.ini
config.default:
[server]
server_online=yes
server_public_name=Mein Server
accept_remote_connections=yes
max_simultaneous_players={{max_players}}
password=
external_mods_dir=
game_mode=0

[game]
world=
spawn=earth
megalodon=no

[networking]
listen_port={{port}}
listen_new_connection_timeout_ms=500
automatic_blacklist=no

[performance]
updates_per_second=25
physics_steps_per_update=8
auto_save_interval_seconds=30
screens_compression_level=2
server_loop_thread_cpu_affinity=-1

notes: Aus den AMP-Vorlagen von CubeCoders erzeugt (MIT), noch nicht im Selbsttest geprüft.
